research.notes: The agenda lists Redwood City, CA, which is the organization's California regional office (not the legal headquarters). Contact details shown are the national headquarters in Boston; no California-specific contact was confirmed on the organization's site. No CA Secretary of State or SAM.gov record was checked.

profile.summary: Citizen Schools is a national education nonprofit founded in 1995. It supports students through hands-on learning projects and career mentors, often led by volunteers from different professions, in schools and extended-learning programs. It operates in several regions, including the California Bay Area.

sources.title: Citizen Schools Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Citizen Schools' California news page names Greenleaf Elementary, Westlake Middle and Redwood City's McKinley Institute of Technology, matching the OUSD MOU titles and the agenda location. The About page confirms the 1995 founding, mentor-led learning, and the Boston address, phone and email. ProPublica confirms the EIN, 501(c)(3) status and Boston location. The summary is neutral and supported.
